title: Max builds a tunnel under the sea (the seagull came along)

beats.text: Max just tried to sink a concrete tunnel. It floated away.
Max wants to drive his family car across this sea strait, right under the water.
He digs under the sea, but forty metres of water squeezes the soaked clay, and mud floods in.
So a grab dredger scoops an open trench instead.
In a dry dock, Max casts a sealed concrete box. Flood it... it floats! It pushes aside more water than it weighs.
Perfect! Floating delivers it. Ballast tanks fill until it's just heavier, and winches lower it into the trench.
Block two lands, but concrete never meets perfectly. The sea sprays in.
A rubber gasket! Then the sea's own pressure squeezes block two home and seals it shut.
Then a ship's dragging anchor cracks the bare tunnel.
Rock armour buries it, and the next anchor just bounces.
Bulkheads out, lights on, and Max drives through, dry.
The car climbs onto the island, and the kids cheer.
The real one: eighty-nine blocks across eighteen kilometres. Would you drive it?
